description: This file implements a COCO evaluation class for object detection, segmentation, and keypoint detection, including methods for preparing results, merging evaluations, and running evaluation metrics, specifically designed for distributed processing.

classes.name: CocoEvaluator
classes.description: Class for evaluating object detection, segmentation, and keypoint detection results using COCO metrics in a distributed setting.

methods.name: convert_to_xywh
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) format to (x, y, width, height) format.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges evaluation results from multiple processes using all_gather, concatenates image IDs and evaluation images.

methods.name: create_common_coco_eval
methods.description: Creates a unified COCO evaluation object from merged image IDs and evaluation images.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Runs per-image evaluation on given images, computes IoU or keypoints, and stores results.
